svg.textArea:
Send what you copy, share or screenshot on a phone straight to a laptop clipboard, over the same Wi-Fi, no cloud.
Android app, Windows tray app, Mac menu bar app, and a web page for iPhones. Code and downloads: https://github.com/BeathovenGala/copycat
Read the views in order. Every number on these diagrams comes from a constant in the code.

g.textArea: Colours and shapes mean the same thing in every view.
g.foreignObject: flowchart LR classDef ok fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef bad fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#D64545,color:#6B0A0A classDef wait fill:#FFE86D,stroke:#A28E26,color:#574900 classDef auto fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef ext fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef default fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#757575,color:#313131 classDef grp fill:#F7F7F7,stroke:#B0B0B0,color:#313131 subgraph colour["Colour"] c1["Green = worked, the happy path"]:::ok c2["Red = failed or stopped"]:::bad c3["Yellow = waiting, retrying, or switched off"]:::wait c4["Blue = automatic, no human involved"]:::auto c5["Grey = outside CopyCat: OS, GitHub, other apps"]:::ext end subgraph shape["Shape"] s1(["Rounded = start or finish"]) s2["Box = an action"] s3{"Diamond = a decision"} s4[("Cylinder = stored data")] end class colour,shape grp

g.textArea: Phone and laptop talk directly over Wi-Fi. GitHub is only used for downloads and updates.

g.textArea: Runs every time the phone needs the laptop. No PIN unless the laptop owner turns auto-connect off.
g.foreignObject:
flowchart TD classDef ok fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef bad fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#D64545,color:#6B0A0A classDef wait fill:#FFE86D,stroke:#A28E26,color:#574900 classDef auto fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef ext fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef default fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#757575,color:#313131 classDef grp fill:#F7F7F7,stroke:#B0B0B0,color:#313131 start(["Phone needs the laptop
app opened, or something to send"]):::ok ping{"Saved address answers
GET /ping?"} use(["Use saved laptop"]):::ok bcast["Broadcast COPYCAT_DISCOVER
listen 1.5 s for replies"]:::auto paired{"Paired before?
has a saved key"} same{"Saved laptop name
among the replies?"} update["Update saved address
laptop IP changed"]:::auto gone(["Not reachable
item waits in queue"]):::wait count{"How many laptops
replied?"} none(["None: type the IP
or retry later"]):::bad choose["Ask: which laptop is yours?"]:::wait pair["POST /pair
empty PIN"]:::auto accept{"Laptop setting:
connect phones automatically?"} pin["Ask for 6-digit PIN
5 wrong tries = 1 min lockout"]:::wait save(["Save name, address, key
paired"]):::ok start --> ping ping -->|"yes"| use ping -->|"no"| bcast bcast --> paired paired -->|"yes"| same same -->|"yes"| update --> use same -->|"no, never switches on its own"| gone paired -->|"no"| count count -->|"0"| none count -->|"exactly 1"| pair count -->|"2 or more"| choose --> pair pair --> accept accept -->|"on, the default"| save accept -->|"off"| pin --> save

g.textArea: Android hides the clipboard from background apps, so CopyCat reacts to the system's own denial log.
g.foreignObject:
sequenceDiagram actor User participant Other as Any other app participant OS as Android clipboard service participant Watch as CopyCat WatchService participant Clip as ClipActivity (invisible) participant Laptop Note over Watch: Needs READ_LOGS (granted once over adb)
and Display over other apps User->>Other: Copy text Other->>OS: Set clipboard OS-->>Watch: Clipboard changed, CopyCat is in the background OS->>OS: Logs Denying clipboard access to com.copycat.app Watch->>Watch: logcat reader spots that line, 400 ms debounce Watch->>Clip: Open invisible screen for a moment Clip->>OS: Read clipboard, allowed because it has focus alt Same text as last time Clip->>Clip: Skip else New text Clip->>Laptop: POST /text Laptop-->>Clip: 200 OK, now on the laptop clipboard end Clip->>Clip: Close, the user app gets focus back Note over OS,Watch: Android shows a pasted-from-clipboard notice each time.
After a phone restart, open CopyCat once to allow log access again.

g.textArea: Nothing sent while apart is lost. Items wait up to 24 hours and go out on the next trigger.
g.foreignObject:
flowchart TD classDef ok fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef bad fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#D64545,color:#6B0A0A classDef wait fill:#FFE86D,stroke:#A28E26,color:#574900 classDef auto fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef ext fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef default fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#757575,color:#313131 classDef grp fill:#F7F7F7,stroke:#B0B0B0,color:#313131 failed(["Send failed
item saved as not delivered"]):::bad svc{"Background service on?
either auto switch enabled"} wifi["Wi-Fi joined callback
wait 3 s for an IP"]:::auto tick["Every 30 s while items wait"]:::auto job["Android job on unmetered Wi-Fi
every 5 min"]:::auto open["User opens CopyCat"] retry["Connect and retry
find laptop, see view 2"]:::auto found{"Laptop found?"} sendall["Send waiting items
oldest first, last 24 h only"]:::ok marked(["Marked sent"]):::ok waitmore(["Keep waiting
for the next trigger"]):::wait old(["Older than 24 h
tap it in the app to resend"]):::wait failed --> svc svc -->|"yes"| wifi svc -->|"yes"| tick svc -->|"no"| job failed --> open wifi --> retry tick --> retry job --> retry open --> retry retry --> found found -->|"yes"| sendall --> marked found -->|"no"| waitmore failed -.->|"after 24 h"| old

g.textArea: Each app checks GitHub for a newer release. Laptops update silently; Android asks the user to confirm.
g.foreignObject:
flowchart LR classDef ok fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef bad fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#D64545,color:#6B0A0A classDef wait fill:#FFE86D,stroke:#A28E26,color:#574900 classDef auto fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef ext fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef default fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#757575,color:#313131 classDef grp fill:#F7F7F7,stroke:#B0B0B0,color:#313131 gh[/"GitHub latest release
api.github.com"/]:::ext subgraph windows["Windows laptop"] w1["30 s after start,
then every 12 h"]:::auto w2["Download CopyCat.exe
as CopyCat.new.exe"]:::auto w3["update.cmd waits for exit,
swaps the file, relaunches"]:::auto w4(["Updated silently"]):::ok end subgraph macos["Mac laptop"] m1["30 s after start,
then every 12 h"]:::auto m2["Download and unzip
CopyCat-mac.zip"]:::auto m3["Shell script swaps the app,
clears quarantine, reopens"]:::auto m4(["Updated silently"]):::ok end subgraph androidp["Android phone"] a1["On app open or service tick,
at most every 6 h"]:::auto a2["Update button and
one notification per version"]:::wait a3["User taps: download APK,
system installer asks to confirm"] a4{"Signed with the same
release key?"} a5(["Installed, settings kept"]):::ok a6(["Rejected by Android"]):::bad end w1 -->|"newer version?"| gh m1 -->|"newer version?"| gh a1 -->|"newer version?"| gh gh -->|"yes, Windows"| w2 --> w3 --> w4 gh -->|"yes, Mac"| m2 --> m3 --> m4 gh -->|"yes, Android"| a2 --> a3 --> a4 a4 -->|"yes"| a5 a4 -->|"no"| a6 class windows,macos,androidp grp
